method: Unchanged original redstone block classes run inside a real World (ahb, allocated without its constructor) with real Chunk (apx) and ExtendedBlockStorage objects from a stub chunk provider. Native: World.setBlock, setBlockMetadataWithNotify, notifyBlocksOfNeighborChange, notifyBlockOfNeighborChange, power queries, doesBlockHaveSolidTopSurface, isBlockNormalCubeDefault, Chunk.func_150807_a/setBlockMetadata, Block drops. Replaced: WorldServer scheduled ticks (copied: HashSet + TreeSet of original NextTickListEntry, 1000 cap, this-tick list), getTotalWorldTime, getGameRules (default GameRules), playSoundEffect/spawnEntityInWorld (recorded), spawnParticle (ignored), getEntitiesWithinAABB (empty), lighting updates (disabled). The wire's blocksNeedingUpdate HashSet is replaced by a fresh one per scenario; the JVM is Java 8+ (HashMap iteration order of Java 8 and later). Terrain is written straight into chunk sections; events of tick t run before tick t (world time advances, then tickUpdates). No random block ticks. Per tick: changed region cells [x,y,z,id,meta], and the call log: E,op event; s,x,y,z,id,meta,flags setBlock; m,x,y,z,meta,flags setBlockMetadataWithNotify; n,x,y,z,source notifyBlockOfNeighborChange; t,x,y,z,id,delay,priority scheduled tick; u,x,y,z,id updateTick; p,name sound; e,item dropped item; T world tick. sounds: [tick,x,y,z,name,volume,pitch]; drops: [tick,x,y,z,item,count,damage]; pending: [x,y,z,id,ticksLeft,priority]; rng: world Random nextInt() after the run.
